text: Lanre Hassan and Company provides estate agency, property and facility management, valuation, and property development services. It is located at 21 Oga Road, Abuja, close to the Central Bank of Nigeria area. The firm supports property owners, occupiers, and other clients who need professional real estate advice.

text: The valuation process starts with collecting and understanding the client's brief. It continues through property inspection, market survey, method selection, analysis, and preparation of the valuation report. The valuation purpose, such as sale, mortgage, acquisition, or compensation, influences the scope of work. Inspection evidence, market evidence, and professional judgement must remain distinct.

text: I encountered differences between classroom procedures and field practice, transportation costs, and difficulty accessing some property information.
